findings.claim: The plan's verification acceptance criteria violate the repository's blocking verification gates by replacing required workspace checks and branding audit with narrower scoped checks.
findings.evidence: Constraints require every behavioral change to pass `cargo check --workspace --lib`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `python3 scripts/enforce-branding.py --check`; the plan acceptance criteria only list `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo test -p librefang-channels sidecar`, UAR-sidecar scoped tests, and `cargo clippy -p librefang-channels --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the full blocking gates to acceptance criteria: `cargo check --workspace --lib`, scoped tests for changed crates, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `python3 scripts/enforce-branding.py --check`.
